data:
This course is primarily designed to help students understand the basics of finance and
banking, operational dynamics and day-to-day transactions at bank branches. It will cover the
finance essentials related to banking, the latest global developments in banking in the areas of lending, risk management, asset liability management and the impact of technology in modern
day banking. It will also give them a practical perspective of the day to day challenges faced
by banks.

Learning Outcome:
1. How banks are functioning today
2. Main banking products
3. What new products and services have come into the market
3. Challenges faced by banks and opportunities available to them
4. The technological changes shaping banking
5. The future of banking
